record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change the tied item embedding output from unit norm to fixed norm 0.75, preserving exact zero padding and width=128. Smaller input magnitudes may reduce GRU gate saturation, while smaller candidate magnitudes may moderate score growth under the mixed ranking/logistic objective. Test this embedding-only change independently of the earlier multi-change timeout. Preserve features, GRU topology, history policy, readout, scoring formula, loss and optimizer; mirror normalization in the predictor writer.
